title: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on KLOS-FM | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono took part in a late-night radio interview for Los Angeles station KLOS-FM on 29 April 1972.

The phone interview was by Elliot Mintz, a presenter on the station. The conversation covered subjects including their forthcoming single ‘Woman Is The N****r Of The World’, and Lennon’s attempts to gain permanent residency in the US.
